source_underscore_markup.interpretation: Balanced, nonempty Project Gutenberg underscore-delimited spans in this retained plain-text member are source-marked emphasis.
source_underscore_markup.tei_mapping: Retain every literal underscore in source order as <c type="emphasis-delimiter">; represent enclosed text with <hi rend="italic" ana="#source-underscore"> fragments. The first fragment carries xml:id and continuations carry corresp.
source_underscore_markup.ambiguity_policy: Fail closed on unmatched, empty, nested, coincident, or blank-line-crossing underscore spans.
source_underscore_markup.locator_contract: One-based Unicode codepoint line and column; span content retains exact source CRLF bytes after UTF-8 encoding.
